prompt: Convert miles per gallon into kilometres per litre and into litres per 100 km using a chain of unit conversions. Round both answers to two decimals.
explanation: A chain of conversions is just multiplication and division by the right factors: multiplying by kilometres-per-mile converts the distance, dividing by litres-per-gallon converts the fuel. Litres per 100 km is the inverse measure, so it divides 100 by the kilometres-per-litre figure -- which is why the guard for a zero input matters, since dividing by zero would give Infinity rather than a number. Naming the factors as final constants makes the formulas readable and keeps the magic numbers in one place.
hints: kilometresPerLitre is one expression: milesPerGallon * KM_PER_MILE / LITRES_PER_GALLON.
For litresPerHundredKm, compute the unrounded km per litre first and divide 100.0 by it -- rounding too early loses accuracy.
Return 0.0 straight away when milesPerGallon <= 0, before any division.
